data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (contando la rutina de Kili).
data.script: Ingrid: Kili's day is like a clock! He always wakes up at six, when the sun touches the lighthouse. … Ingrid: He usually has breakfast with us: bread, seeds and one strawberry. … Ingrid: At eight he delivers the mail. He often sings while he flies — very badly! … Ingrid: In the afternoon he sometimes visits the ships in the port. … Ingrid: He never flies at night. Night is for sleeping in his nest. … Ingrid: And on Sundays? On Sundays Kili does absolutely nothing. It's his favourite habit!

Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the girl with black plaits and a purple shirt? … Maya: That is Lia. Look, Lia is jumping with a skipping rope. … Diego: And who is the boy with curly brown hair and a green shirt? … Maya: That is Bruno. Look, Bruno is running after the ball. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving.
